An earlier first run took 21.388 seconds including runtime initialization; not a pure VM boot measurement.
An APK installation attempt was stopped after 66.871 seconds; final probe uses built-in tools. Internet/package installation compatibility is not established.
The memory option limits workload memory, not total host footprint.
vmmap physical footprint snapshots are approximate process accounting, not isolated whole-machine memory deltas.
API server historical footprint peak was 709.5M during setup; steady idle footprint is not the provisioning peak.
No build, Agent, pasta, Landlock, seccomp enforcement, cross-World isolation or hostile-workload acceptance tests.
Restart preserves files, not process state.
